changes.summary: With export_computed false, nested blocks marked computed on the container but containing user-settable children are no longer excluded entirely; only computed leaf attributes inside those blocks are omitted from export output.
With export_computed false, nested blocks whose fields are all nil after sanitization are removed from exported configuration instead of appearing as empty block shells.
With export_computed false, when every direct child of a nested block is excluded as computed, the whole nested block path is omitted rather than exporting an empty block.
Unresolvable optional references inside nested maps or list elements are tracked using full attribute paths, and generated unresolvable-reference names use path segments instead of leaf names only.
When include_state_file is enabled, exported terraform.tfstate sets meta.schema_version from each resource type's provider schema version instead of always using 0.

related_export_changes.summary: With export_computed false, user-settable fields inside the config nested block are retained in export output instead of the whole block being dropped as computed.
Unresolvable-reference sidecar output may include nested optional references that were previously missed and may use path-based generated variable names.
Re-exported terraform.tfstate may contain non-zero meta.schema_version values for resource types with migrated schemas, affecting plan after import or refresh.
